```{r load_data}
membrane_grouped_data <- read.delim("/nesi/nobackup/uc04105/PDB_alpha/relative_freq_aa_atm_fl.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```


## Including Plots
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(devtools)
#install.packages("factoextra")
library(factoextra)

```

```{r}
normalized_membrane_data <- membrane_grouped_data %>% mutate(across(4:23, ~./total_aa_count))

```



```{r}
normalized_membrane_data<-mutate(normalized_membrane_data, ID = row_number())

# create a new column `x` with the three columns collapsed together
normalized_membrane_data$new_id <- apply( normalized_membrane_data[ ,c(3,24)], 1 , paste , collapse = "-" )

rownames(normalized_membrane_data) <- normalized_membrane_data[,25]

res.pc <- prcomp(normalized_membrane_data[,-c(1,2,3,24,25)], center = TRUE, scale.=TRUE)


fviz_pca_ind(res.pc,
             col.ind = "cos2", # Color by the quality of representation
             gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
```

```{r}
fviz_pca_var(res.pc,
             col.var = "contrib", # Color by contributions to the PC
             gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
fviz_pca_ind(res.pc,
             col.ind = "cos2", # Color by the quality of representation
             gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
             repel = TRUE     # Avoid text overlapping
             )
```

```{r}

group_variable <-as.factor(normalized_membrane_data$type)
fviz_pca_ind(res.pc,
             geom = "point",
             habillage = group_variable, # Use the grouping vector here
             addEllipses = TRUE,
             palette = "Paired", # Use a color palette
             legend.title = "Species",
             repel = TRUE # Avoid text overlaps
             ) 
```

```{r}
fviz_pca_biplot(res.pc, repel = TRUE,
                col.var = "#2E9FDF", # Variables color
                col.ind = "#696969"  # Individuals color
                )
```
